title: BSF Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 34 Sub-Inspector Posts
description: Directorate General, Border Security Force (BSF), has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 34 Sub-Inspector Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in 12th, Diploma, or ANM can use this chance and apply for the BSF Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
